sec_cockpit.title: Smart Cockpit
sec_cockpit.sub: Transforming traditional vehicles into smart mobile spaces.
sec_cockpit.c1_d: This project focuses on developing a next-generation HMI infotainment system, including both hardware and software, tailored to Chery’s vehicle design and functional requirements. It covers HMI system development, intelligent voice avatar design, third-party voice integration, and end-to-end hardware and software support.
sec_cockpit.c2_d: This test cockpit serves as a versatile development and validation platform compatible with multiple ZEEKR production and concept vehicles across different wheelbase configurations. It integrates a wide range of smart hardware and mechanical systems. The project covers styling design, mechanical engineering, hardware integration, wiring design, and multi-screen software demonstrations, including the instrument cluster, center display, passenger display, rear display, HUD, and enhanced A-pillar visualization.
sec_cockpit.c3_d: Unveiled at Auto Shanghai 2024, this smart cockpit experience immerses users in Chery’s virtual ecosystem through VR technology. Integrated with in-car fragrance systems and a starlight roof, it delivers four themed interactive scenarios, while enabling natural voice-based interactions with the in-vehicle assistant.
sec_cockpit.c4_d: An in-vehicle racing game designed for multi-modal interaction, supporting various control methods including steering wheel buttons, Bluetooth controllers, mobile-based virtual controllers, and touchscreens, catering to diverse user preferences.
sec_cockpit.c5_d: This entertainment cockpit integrates ambient lighting, audio systems, steering wheel controls, braking, and acceleration into a unified gaming experience. Players can operate vehicles using the physical steering wheel, freely exploring virtual environments. By leveraging connected vehicle technologies, real-world vehicle functions are replicated within the game, delivering an experience consistent with actual driving and infotainment systems.
sec_cockpit.c6_d: Using Unreal Engine 4 (UE4), the Audi e-tron was recreated in a high-fidelity simulation environment to support the design team in developing vehicle styling, controls, and interaction experiences. The final system enables immersive VR-based road testing, seamlessly blending virtual and real-world elements.
sec_cockpit.c7_d: A VR-based driving simulation platform developed by a Tsinghua University research team. The system recreates realistic road environments, including traffic signals, surrounding vehicles, and pedestrians. It is used to study driver behavior, decision-making, and human–vehicle–environment interactions, with a focus on how cognition, emotion, and attention impact driving performance.
sec_cockpit.c8_d: A simulation platform for HMI design validation, supporting driving scenario reconstruction, MR interaction, dynamic lighting, and spatial audio. Equipped with high-resolution displays, high-performance rendering systems, and MR devices, it enables immersive and multi-sensory design evaluation.
sec_cockpit.c9_d: This platform provides 3D modeling and data support for vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) systems, including 3D Tiles for roads, roadside facilities, and buildings, as well as data in GLB, GeoJSON, and SHP formats. It delivers detailed road network data and independent object models such as traffic lights and cameras. The system establishes a robust data foundation to support intelligent transportation and autonomous driving applications.

sec_hmi.title: HMI
sec_hmi.sub: The communication bridge and interaction window between humans and vehicles.
sec_hmi.c1_d: A next-generation HMI system designed for premium sedan models, featuring a smooth interaction experience and a modern, refined visual language.
sec_hmi.c2_d: Designed for Chery’s concept vehicle, this 3D HMI system integrates an intelligent voice assistant, enabling drivers and passengers to control vehicle functions more intuitively. The system minimizes interaction friction, enhancing both driving focus and overall user experience.
sec_hmi.c3_t: BAIC – VR-Based Rear Seat HMI System
sec_hmi.c3_d: A VR-based HMI system designed for rear-seat passengers. Compared to traditional headrest or ceiling-mounted screens, VR devices offer a more immersive and cost-effective viewing experience. The system supports entertainment, social, and productivity applications, creating a private and engaging in-cabin environment. Through Bluetooth connectivity, users can interact with the vehicle’s HMI system to control features such as climate, seat settings, and navigation without removing the headset.
sec_hmi.c4_d: High-quality live wallpapers created for ZEEKR, providing delicate and realistic visual effects that change dynamically with the environment and time, greatly enhancing cabin immersion.
sec_hmi.c5_d: A 3D HMI cockpit system that integrates navigation, entertainment, and vehicle controls through spatial interfaces and card-based interactions. By leveraging depth, motion, and real-time feedback, it enhances usability and immersion. The system also introduces lightweight task guidance and virtual assistant prompts to improve user engagement, while ensuring safety through adaptive interaction strategies based on driving conditions.
sec_hmi.c6_t: Smart Motorcycle Helmet with AR HUD
sec_hmi.c6_d: A smart motorcycle helmet featuring AR-based HUD capabilities, supporting navigation, eye tracking, and real-time environmental awareness. Designed for lightweight comfort and enhanced riding safety, it integrates augmented reality, 360° situational visibility, and voice control, allowing riders to stay focused on the road without relying on mobile devices.
sec_hmi.c7_d: Addresses the limitations of traditional in-vehicle interaction, such as inflexibility, deep functional hierarchies, and complex operations. By leveraging AI-generated responses to user needs, the system focuses on response efficiency and content accuracy, providing diversified interaction interfaces and proactive services. It also delivers research and analysis on in-vehicle generative interaction markets, scenario requirement analysis, product solution design, and technical feasibility evaluation reports.
sec_hmi.c8_d: Builds an HMI design evaluation and simulation system, covering driving scenario reconstruction, in-cabin MR interactive experiences, dynamic lighting, environmental sound and audio design restoration, and core networking modules. Equipped with high-definition displays, high-performance rendering, MR devices, and control software, it supports multi-sensory design presentation and scientific testing, enabling continuous HMI design optimization.

sec_vpa.title: VPA
sec_vpa.sub: The 'brain' and 'soul' of the Smart Cockpit.
sec_vpa.c1_t: Great Wall – Digital Avatar & In-Vehicle Assistant
sec_vpa.c1_d: Great Wall Motors’ ORA series integrates an intelligent voice assistant and a digital avatar into the in-vehicle system. During driving, the avatar accompanies the user by providing voice feedback and prompts.
sec_vpa.c2_d: The Great Wall Motors Tank 300 series features an in-vehicle intelligent voice assistant. Different models are paired with digital assistants of different genders, which provide voice feedback and prompts based on the driver’s actions throughout the journey.

sec_ent.title: Cabin Entertainment
sec_ent.sub: In-car entertainment systems have become indispensable smart companions for users.
sec_ent.c1_d: ADiGO World, deployed in GAC Aion vehicles, is one of the first in-car ecosystem entertainment systems in China to integrate vehicle TBOX driving data. The system collects user driving behavior data in real time and reflects it through dynamic changes in a virtual planetary ecosystem. Users can grow their unique virtual planet based on driving duration, mileage, and other metrics.
sec_ent.c2_d: An in-car racing game that allows users to enjoy an immersive gaming experience with friends. The driver controls the game using the accelerator, brake pedal, and steering wheel.
sec_ent.c3_d: A highly realistic racing game developed for Hyundai, designed to simulate real driving experiences. The game uses advanced physics engines and graphics technologies to deliver engaging gameplay and a wide selection of tracks.
sec_ent.c4_d: This system supports multiple control modes to match different user preferences, including real cockpit hardware such as steering wheel, brake, accelerator, vibrating seats, and ambient lighting. It also supports multiplayer interaction via Bluetooth controllers, mobile virtual controllers, and touchscreens. Using a real steering wheel enhances the realism and enjoyment of the racing experience.
sec_ent.c5_d: This system leverages cloud computing to shift game resources and processing power from local devices to remote servers, streaming game content to in-vehicle entertainment systems or personal devices. It enables passengers to enjoy high-quality gaming experiences without relying on local hardware performance.
sec_ent.c6_d: Antolin’s music game system integrates seamlessly with in-car ambient lighting, audio systems, and seat vibration. Players interact by tapping the steering wheel or clapping to match the rhythm. During gameplay, the display shows visuals while lighting, sound, seat vibration, and even climate systems respond dynamically, creating an immersive audiovisual experience.
sec_ent.c7_d: Built on Faurecia hardware, this light entertainment system is designed for the rear seats of the Hongqi H9. Users interact through rear touchscreens, enabling casual gaming experiences during short travel periods.
sec_ent.c8_d: Kart Party is a virtual racing game where players enter the game world by acquiring a vehicle license. Players can purchase complete vehicles and a wide range of components, including functional, performance, decorative, and consumable parts. These can be obtained through race points, task rewards, and daily check-ins, allowing users to upgrade and customize their vehicles. The game also incorporates blockchain technology to build a decentralized ecosystem.
sec_ent.c9_d: A virtual pet development game created for Geely, known as Super POC. The game integrates with in-car entertainment features, allowing users to interact by raising virtual pets. It enhances user engagement, enriches the driving experience, and promotes social interaction among users.
sec_ent.c10_d: A multiplayer motion-interactive game designed for social and party scenarios. In vehicles, users interact through microphones and front cameras for singing and upper-body motion matching. In exhibition environments, larger spaces and screens enable full-body group dancing and singing experiences.
sec_ent.c11_d: An interactive game combining motion sensing and entertainment. Players can control virtual tennis actions through body movements in rear-seat or exhibition scenarios. The project is designed to provide an engaging and interactive experience, suitable for both in-car entertainment and public demonstrations.
sec_ent.c12_d: Built on generative AI capabilities, this system introduces personified agents with growth mechanisms. It forms a closed-loop ecosystem around three core modules: agent development, exploration gameplay, and multiplayer interactive spaces. The system supports continuous content generation and relationship building, providing users with an evolving and long-term companion experience.

sec_vrar.title: VR/AR
sec_vrar.c1_d: An in-car AR puzzle game experience that combines augmented reality with puzzle-solving gameplay. It includes features such as hidden clues inside the vehicle, AR interactive puzzles, AR maze challenges, and narrative-based puzzle scenarios. Players complete challenges through interactions such as image recognition, augmented reality, gyroscope input, and touch controls. The experience was showcased at the Mercedes-Benz booth at CES and received strong user engagement.
sec_vrar.c2_d: An innovative gesture-controlled game developed for Hyundai, utilizing advanced gesture recognition technology to enable intuitive in-car interaction. The project enhances in-cabin interactivity and entertainment, demonstrating Hyundai’s technological capabilities. It increases engagement during driving while reflecting a forward-looking approach to user needs and in-car experience.
sec_vrar.c3_t: Apple Vision Pro – Digital Vehicle Prototype
sec_vrar.c3_d: A system that enables rapid presentation of a full-scale (1:1) digital vehicle prototype. Through device-based mixed reality interaction, it supports the visualization and interaction of colors, materials, environments, and design solutions. It also allows multiple users and devices to collaboratively interact with the same digital vehicle data, improving cross-team collaboration and decision-making efficiency.
sec_vrar.c4_d: An independently developed multi-device casual gaming platform based on navigation positioning. Built on navigation data, it creates an augmented reality experience that integrates the real and virtual worlds, delivering a new form of social and visual interaction.
sec_vrar.c5_t: Toyota IZOA – VR Mixed Reality Driving Experience
sec_vrar.c5_d: A simulated driving experience that combines a new vehicle model with virtual racing environments. Built with motion-based driving equipment, it creates a realistic intelligent cockpit that users can physically sit in and operate. The motion seat provides real-time feedback such as vibration and collision effects during driving.

sec_other.title: Others
sec_other.sub: Other cutting-edge technology showcases and partnerships.
sec_other.c1_t: Neta Auto – AR Virtual Launch Event
sec_other.c1_d: An online launch event for the Neta U520U/400U, featuring a virtual stage built with 3D technology combined with real human footage. Different themed visual effects are presented throughout the event, while real vehicle footage is integrated into the virtual stage. The system showcases the Neta U series from multiple perspectives, including both exterior and interior details.
sec_other.c2_d: Provided high-precision vehicle modeling services for Lenovo using advanced 3D modeling technologies to create realistic vehicle models. The project enhances presentation quality in VR and AR applications, while improving user interaction and immersion.
sec_other.c3_d: An AR-based system for personalized vehicle configuration in dealerships, enabling high-precision 3D model visualization on mobile devices such as tablets and smartphones. It allows customers to view detailed vehicle structures, including component-level displays, as well as interactive demonstrations such as door and sunroof opening and closing.
sec_other.c4_d: An AR-based vehicle presentation featuring visual effects to demonstrate aerodynamic performance and autonomous driving capabilities. Through enhanced visualizations, it showcases airflow behavior, radar sensing accuracy, and simulated real-road driving scenarios using 3D technology, providing an intuitive understanding of vehicle technologies.

intro.title: CAAC Exam Simulation Training
intro.subtitle: Safe · Low Cost · High Fidelity · Standardized

pillars.p1_d: CAAC promotes digital and simulated training, opening policy dividends.
pillars.p2_d: The pilot shortage has become a major issue, and demand has surged following the liberalization of the low-altitude airspace economy.
pillars.p3_d: Drone schools and aviation colleges connect directly to improve teaching efficiency and pass rates.
pillars.p4_d: Covering plant protection, logistics, mapping, patrol, and rescue with customized courses.

subject1.title: Subject 1: Theory & Assembly
subject1.subtitle: Mainly tests the mastery of basic knowledge such as laws, flight principles, and aviation meteorology.
subject1.row1_d: Provides 'Practice' and 'Exam' modes. Systematic knowledge covers aviation regulations, meteorology, flight principles, etc. Strictly follows CAAC standards, generating a report immediately upon submission.
subject1.row2_d: Students first select a model to preview the aircraft or recognize parts. Then enter the assembly stage with real-time progress. The system automatically calculates scores upon completion and supports viewing history.

subject2.title: Subject 2: Practical Flight
subject2.subtitle: Tests the 'control' over the drone. Challenges hand coordination, spatial orientation, and psychological quality.
subject2.card1_sub: Maintain hover in designated airspace and complete 360° fixed-axis spin. Meets standards of 'height deviation ≤0.5m, horizontal displacement ≤1m, uniform spin velocity'.
subject2.c1_s1_d: Click 'Hover Calibration' to stabilize the drone at the designated initial altitude.
subject2.c1_s2_d: Maintain stable throttle, slowly push/pull rudder to complete spin at uniform angular velocity.
subject2.c1_s3_d: Stop accurately at the initial point. System automatically generates score and review.
subject2.card2_sub: A key subject testing comprehensive handling, requiring the pilot to fly a standard figure-8 route within designated airspace.
subject2.c2_s1_d: Accurately hover above the center circle within 1 minute, focusing on micro-control training.
subject2.c2_s2_d: Symmetrical and smooth figure-8 route, maintaining uniform speed and fixed altitude.
subject2.c2_s3_d: Return accurately and hover at the starting point after flight, testing landing precision.

bvlos.title: BVLOS — Ground Station Ops
bvlos.subtitle: Scheduled route takeoff, cruise, turning, point landing. Meets 'route deviation ≤50m, altitude deviation ≤5m, command delay ≤2s'.
bvlos.card_sub: Maintain hover in designated airspace and complete 360° fixed-axis spin. Meets standards.
bvlos.s1_d: Build airspace meeting CAAC requirements. Support simulating real electromagnetic interference in urban and mountainous scenes.
bvlos.s2_d: Display attitude, track, battery data. Simulate faults like link interruption and signal delay.
bvlos.s3_d: CAAC official scoring rules. Highlight violations and deduction reasons, providing improvement advice.

modes.title: Training Modes
modes.subtitle: Process for building scientific muscle memory + spatial orientation.
modes.m1_d: Open, unconstrained practice environment. Control the drone freely with no task limits. Suitable for novices to familiarize with basics or experts to test parameters. Supports free setting adjustments to explore techniques.
modes.m2_d: Racing challenge gameplay with fixed tracks and checkpoints. Cross and reach the finish line in specified order. Tracks feature obstacles. System auto-records time, testing route planning and high-speed handling.

special.title: Specialized Application Training
special.sub: Training modules for specific economic segments. Simulate real work environments for specific industry skills.
special.c1_d: Master the skills of specialized cleaning drones for PV panels to achieve efficient and safe O&M management.
special.c2_d: Focusing on large areas of farmland, forests, pastures, etc., helping students master route planning and autonomous operation.
special.c3_d: Simulate complex terrains like urban dense areas and mountains to master low-altitude flight and multi-angle shooting.
special.c4_d: Simulate complex scenes like mountains and islands to master takeoff and landing in difficult terrains.
special.c5_d: Focus on facility inspection scenes like roads, bridges, and pipe networks to master hazard troubleshooting.
special.c6_d: Simulate disaster scenes like earthquakes and floods to master rapid takeoff and low-altitude penetration.
special.c7_d: High-simulation training to master racing drone control skills and stunt actions, reducing equipment loss risks.

hero.title: Careers
hero.subtitle: Join us in driving business expansion in the Japanese market.

intro.p1: At Hummingbird Inc., we are accelerating our global business development across multiple fields, including smart cockpit systems, in-vehicle entertainment, low-altitude mobility, AI solutions, and VR content.
intro.p2: We welcome professionals who are eager to create new collaboration opportunities with Japanese companies and contribute to the continuous growth of our business.

message.title: Who We Are Looking For
message.p1: We are not simply looking for sales representatives. We seek professionals who can understand client challenges, provide thoughtful solutions, and build long-term trusted relationships.
message.p2: We also value individuals who can connect content, technology, and business, and who are motivated to proactively create new value through innovation and collaboration.
